Name: Crab Farmer's Bumper Harvest
Author: Axophy
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/M5WXmhYH/CFBH-title.png[/img]
[line]
[b][size=5]🌈 Description[/size][/b]
[size=4][b] [/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Crab Farmer's Bumper Harvest has added [b]32 new fish for crab pot, 12 new aquatic crops, 8 new cookings, 9 new forages, 7 machines and artisan goods[/b][/color] about fish [color=#D4D4D8]into the game, intended for enriching the gaming experience of fishing and crab catching, makes crab catching to be more lucrative.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8] [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]The capture time of these fish and the growth time of crops cover all four seasons of the year, and each season has its specific products, so that you can derive pleasure from harvesting a variety of products.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8] [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]If you enjoy this mod, just scrolling up and hit that Endorse button. It would be the best support for this mod![/color]
[line]
[b][size=5]🦀 Fish & Forages [/size][/b]
[size=4][b] [/b][/size]
Including 11 freshwater fish, 21 ocean fish and 9 ocean forages.
New ocean forages can be found on the beach of Pelican Town and Ginger Island Farm.
To balance the catch rate, mod has adjucted the catch rate of vanilla fish.
[size=4][b] [/b][/size]
[size=3]Relevant information: [/size]
[spoiler][list]
[*]All year : Starfish, Barnacle, Cat's Eyes Turban, Razor Clam, Blue Crab, River Mussel, River Shrimp, River Snail[/*]
[*]All year (After Rain) : Grass Frog, Bullfrog, Giant Salamander, Axolotl[/*]
[*]Spring : Hermit Crab, Abalone, Sea Intestine, Sea Anemone, Brook Floater[/*]
[*]Summer : King Crab, Jellyfish, Blue Lobster, Peacock Mantis Shrimp, Sponge[/*]
[*]Fall : Mantis Shrimp, Fiddler Crab, Brown Crab, Horseshoe Crab, Hairy Crab[/*]
[*]Winter : Giant Isopod, Sea Slug, Moon Scallop, Geoduck, Soft Shelled Turtle[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[line]
[b][size=5]🌱 Aquatic Crops [/size][/b]
[size=4][b] [/b][/size]
Yeah, that's right - none of these crops need watering at all!
Just need to plant them near by a body of water and waiting for mature.
 
Relevant information:
[spoiler][list]
[*]Water Bamboo : planted in spring & fall, seeds from Pierre[/*]
[*]Water Caltrop : planted in spring, seeds from Pierre [/*]
[*]Water Chestnut : planted in spring & summer, seeds from Pierre[/*]
[*]Water Dropwort : planted in fall & winter, seeds from Pierre [/*]
[*]Water Hyacinth : planted in spring & summer, seeds from Pierre[/*]
[*]Arrowhead : planted in spring & winter, seeds from Pierre[/*]
[*]Gorgon Nuts : planted in fall, seeds from Pierre[/*]
[*]Monochoria : planted in fall, seeds from Pierre [/*]
[*]Reed : planted in all year, seeds from Pierre[/*]
[*]Water Shield : planted in fall, seeds from Sandy [/*]
[*]Canna : planted in summer, seeds from Sandy[/*]
[*]Lotus : planted in summer, seeds from Sandy [/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[line]
[b][size=5]🍢 Cookings[/size][/b]
[b][size=4] [/size][/b]
These foods have unique Eastern characteristics, some of them have useful buffs. 
Most recipes of these dishes come from NPC.

Relevant information:
[spoiler][list]
[*]Bullfrog Pot : selled in fish shop[/*]
[*]Jellyfish Salad : selled during Dance of the Moonlight Jellies[/*]
[*]Lotus Root Bone Soup : Marnie 6 hearts[/*]
[*]Lotus Seed Soup : Caroline 4 hearts [/*]
[*]Oden : selled during Night Market[/*]
[*]Seaweed Egg Soup : fishing 4 levels[/*]
[*]Steamed Hairy Crab : Gus 9 hearts[/*]
[*]Water Shield Egg Soup : Evelyn 6 hearts[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[line]
[b][size=5]🥫 Machines & Artisan Goods[/size][/b]

The new machine covers the entire game process, from unlocking in the early game to the later stages when arriving Ginger Island.
Some of the machines can process multiple fish at once, making them ideal for handling the output from crab pots.
Henceforth, the fish smoker is no longer the only choice for Fisherman!
 
[b]If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] is installed, you can change the price multiplier and set whether these mechines can keep quality.[/b]
 
Relevant information:
[spoiler][list]
[*]Aquatic Drying Rack : fishing 4 level unlocked, need 3 fish to product a Dried Fish. Only work in sunny days[/*]
[*]Deluxe Solar Panel :  selled in Qi's Walnut Room. A solar panel with heigher efficiency[/*]
[*]Aquatic Freezer : selled in Qi's Walnut Room, need 1 battery pack and 10 fish to product a Crated Frozen Fish[/*]
[*]Can Wlding Machine : selled in fish shop after fishing 10 level,  need 1 empty can and 2 fish to product a Canned Fish[/*]
[*]Fish Grinder : fishing 9 level unlocked, need 1 fish to product a bag of Surimi[/*]
[*]Salt Maker : fishing 8 level unlocked, can be used for producting Salt. Only work outside and in sunny days[/*]
[*]Pickled Fish Jar : fishing 8 level unlocked, need 1 salt and 1 fish to product a Salted Fish [/*]
[/list]
[center][img width=686,height=539]https://i.ibb.co/cc7rjwGs/2026-07-02-214232.png[/img][/center]
[/spoiler]
[line]
[color=#d4d4d8][size=5][b]🌎 Languages[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b] [/b][/size][/color]
English and Simplified Chinese(简体中文) are supported.
If you are willing to create a translation for it, you don't need to inform me, just feel free to do it :D
Please ensure that the translation mod only includes the files of i18n.
[line]
[b][size=5][color=#d4d4d8]📌 [/color]Requirements[/size][/b]
[size=4][b] [/b][/size]
 These mods are required to install:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Pathoschild[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher - Pathoschild [/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager - EscaMMC[/url] [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs - zombifier[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore -  spacechase0[/url] [/*]
[/list]Big shoutout to these mod authors!
Without their hard work, I'd never be able to turn my ideas into reality!
